question: Which among the following is an example of Phylum Mammalia of Animal Kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mammalia:-

 
 
• The word "Mammalia" comes from the Latin word "mamma," which means "breast" or "udder."
 
• This is because mammals produce milk to feed their young.
 
• Some other examples of animals belonging to the Phylum Mammalia are humans, dogs, cats, whales, and elephants. 
 
• Rat belongs to the Phylum Mammalia of the Animal Kingdom.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crocodiles** are large reptiles that are found in freshwater habitats.
 
• 
 
 
• They have a** long and powerful tail, sharp teeth,** and a tough skin.
 
 
 
• **Hens** are domesticated birds that are commonly kept for their eggs and meat.
 
 
• They have a **beak, feathers, and wings, **and are known for their clucking sound.
 
 
 
• **Pigeons** are also domesticated birds that are often used for racing, as messenger birds, or as pets.
 
 
• They have a **plump body, short neck, and small head.**
